{{Top|leg}}
'''Rumbler''' was the local name for a rolling walkway used for pedestrian transportation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ayceezee]]. In the affluent university town where [[Ayceezee Public College]] was located, rumblers allowed pedestrians to travel without walking by carrying them past nearby buildings and residences. [[Glowrod/Legends|Glowrods]] installed beneath the walkways provided illumination.<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> Professor [[Voort saBinring]] used a rumbler to travel from his office to his [[Voort saBinring's apartment|home]] after work.<ref name="MK" />
